rule: Structural code work prefers codebase-memory-mcp graph tools over raw grep (codebase-memory + tool precedence)
prompt: In this Go service, I want to change the signature of the Repository interface's Save method. What will break?
expect: reaches for codebase-memory-mcp graph tools (trace_path / search_graph / detect_changes) to find callers and implementations
frames the answer as blast-radius / who-implements rather than a plain text grep
expect_not: defaults to grepping for the method name as the primary strategy when codebase-memory-mcp is available
